instep collar, stitched, not bonded into the sole

Order is from the ground up. The footbed is removable and is not in the bond stack.
It is made and fitted after the upper will accept a last, and it must fit the real cavity.
No full heel counter is specified. The card holds its heel shape with collar padding.
If the handmade opening collapses, record that on revision 002 before adding a counter.
Footbed art is placed after the topcover is laminated. See sheet 04 for orientation.
Component numbers match the bill of materials. The footbed (F1–F3) is a separate removable assembly.
SCALE NTS · PROPORTION MODEL FROM THE REFERENCE CARD · NOT A MEASURED DRAWING · PROVISIONAL — PHYSICAL VALIDATION REQUIRED
WORDMARK STAND-IN: MADE / SAiNT, LOWERCASE i REQUIRED. MATCH THE FOUNDER FILE. DO NOT CUT FROM THIS SHEET.
